dashboard.label: SOC Playground — Attack Detection Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real SPL detections for the simulated pseudo-attack techniques. Proof of ingestion and detection in one view.

panel.title: Attk101 — SSH Brute Force (Linux auth.log) — top source IPs

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "from\s+(?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count by src_ip, host | sort - count | head 10

panel.title: Ingestion — events in last 24h by sourcetype

search.query: index=soc_capstone earliest=-24h | stats count by sourcetype | sort - count

panel.title: Attk102 — Local Account Creation (Security 4720) + Admin group adds

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732) | eval action=case(EventCode=="4720","ACCOUNT_CREATED", EventCode=="4728","ADDED_TO_LOCALGROUP", EventCode=="4732","ADDED_TO_GLOBALGROUP") | eval created=if(isnull(TargetUserName) OR TargetUserName="-" OR TargetUserName="", "N/A", mvindex(TargetUserName,0)) | eval details=Account_Name." -> ".created | table _time, host, action, details | sort - _time
index=soc_capstone DownloadString earliest=-24h | stats count by host, sourcetype | sort - count

panel.title: Attk103 — Network connections from PowerShell (Sysmon EID 3)

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational powershell.exe earliest=-24h | stats count by host | sort - count
index=soc_capstone ((sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=1102) OR (sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "EventID>4<")) | table _time host | sort - _time

panel.title: Attk101 — SSH failed logins by source IP (Kali)

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" earliest=-24h | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "from\s+(?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count by host, src_ip | sort - count | head 20

panel.title: Windows — Sysmon network connections (EID 3) by host

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "EventID>3<" earliest=-24h | stats count by host | sort - count | head 20

panel.title: Proof of ingestion — event count by sourcetype

search.query: index=soc_capstone | stats count by sourcetype | sort - count
index=soc_capstone | stats count, sparkline(count,1h) as trend by host, sourcetype | sort - count
